name: Flip of the Coin → Quicksilver — v1
description: v1: 16-bar overlap. Flip winding down (bars 192-208) blends with Quicksilver's breakdown/build (bars 64-80). Quicksilver drops at bar 80 as Flip exits. Natural bass handoff — Quicksilver's entry zone has no bass content.

tracks.name: Flip of the Coin (Extended Mix)
tracks.notes: 4A (F minor). Last peak at bars 176-184. Wind-down from bar 192, sparse at 200 (rms 0.109), ends ~208.

tracks.name: Quicksilver
tracks.notes: 3A (Bb minor). Breakdown at bar 64 (rms 0.159), deepest at 72 (no bass, lf=0.47), DROP at 80 (rms 0.315, full bass). first_beat_sample may need phase alignment calibration.

transitions.notes: 16-bar overlap: Flip 192-208 / Quicksilver 64-80. Flip naturally dying (rms 0.276→0.109). Quicksilver enters in breakdown with no bass (lf=0.47), builds 8 bars, drops at bar 80 with full bass. Incoming bass killed on entry, ramps to full — cooperates with Quicksilver's natural structure since bass doesn't arrive until the drop. 50/50 crossover at overlap bar 8. Key: 4A→3A = adjacent Camelot, perfect harmonic mix.
